text:
Maria Sanchez: Hey @Cheng, re-requesting a quick pass on PR #842 (svc-routing). I pushed fixes for the KV allocator race and updated the smoke + alloc unit tests. CI passed on my branch locally. Can someone give one more approval so I can take the 2-3pm merge slot? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/842

Cheng Liu: Looking now. Quick Q — did you keep the old allocator fallback for odd-node-count? I left a tiny comment inline.

Maria Sanchez: Yep — kept fallback and added a unit test. Pushed a tiny follow-up fixing the nil check. Tests updated.

Samir Patel: I ran the smoke e2e and saw a flake on canary when shard count = 1. Try running `pytest tests/e2e/test_shard.py::test_single_shard -q` — if green I'll approve.

Maria Sanchez: Running that now, will push if green. thx.

canary-bot: Deploy canary build 2026-03-18T13:45 UTC for branch svc-routing-842 started.

Maria Sanchez: Canary passed locally, pushed squashed commit. Requesting approval again.

David Kim: Quick nit on a log line, but not blocking. One approve from Cheng or Sam and we can merge.

Cheng Liu: Approved. Left an optional suggestion inline.

Samir Patel: Approved — ran that e2e, it's stable. :thumbsup:

Maria Sanchez: Thanks both — grabbing 2:05pm slot and will monitor post-merge. Reassigning release-duty to @David. Will post canary metrics in #eng-runtime.
